common.footerSandbox: Sandbox only. Cleared is not affiliated with PayPal.

landing.h1: Get your held PayPal money moving, with proof ready before PayPal asks.
landing.intro: Cleared is an AI agent for small cross-border sellers. It builds a proof pack for every payment, explains holds with PayPal's own rules, and drafts dispute replies from that proof. It never sends anything to PayPal without your approval.
landing.step1: A real PayPal sandbox payment arrives through a webhook.
landing.step2: Cleared builds its proof pack from synthetic client files.
landing.step3: A sandbox chargeback opens a dispute; you approve the drafted reply.
landing.step4: Press "<en>Simulate PayPal's decision (sandbox only)</en>" and watch the money get released.
landing.demoNote: No PayPal account or keys needed. Workspace lasts until 16 Dec 2026.
landing.real: Real: PayPal sandbox APIs and responses, PayPal's published rules. Synthetic: every person, chat and file in the demo.
landing.checkBody: If {email} can sign in, a link is on its way. It works once and expires in 15 minutes.

scenario.title: Dispute scenario
scenario.intro: A real PayPal sandbox run: a card payment, a chargeback from the buyer's bank, and PayPal's own states as they change. Only the decision step is simulated, and it is labelled.
scenario.running: A dispute scenario is running in this workspace.
scenario.llmCap: Today's AI budget for the demo is used up, so a new scenario can't start. Try again after 00:00 UTC.

step.seed_pack: Proof pack filled: agreed scope, delivery and the client's acceptance
step.chargeback: The buyer's bank opened a chargeback
step.evidence_filed: Your evidence is filed with PayPal

wait.evidence_step: Waiting for PayPal to open the evidence step. It usually opens within ~15 min.
wait.evidence_filed: Waiting for your approved reply. Reviewing and approving the drafted reply arrives with dispute support.
wait.decision: PayPal usually offers the decision step within ~5 min of your evidence.
wait.outcome: PayPal usually resolves the case within ~10 min of the decision.

scenario.outcomePayout: Resolved; seller keeps the money (PayPal covered the case)
scenario.timedOut: PayPal didn't reach a final state within 60 minutes. Start a new scenario to try again.
scenario.failed: The scenario stopped before it finished.
scenario.decideHelp: Stands in for PayPal's own review. Only available in the sandbox, after your evidence is filed.
scenario.decideConfirm: This asks the PayPal sandbox to decide the case in your favour, standing in for PayPal's review. Real PayPal never offers this.

blocked.no_adjudicate_link: PayPal isn't ready yet: it hasn't offered the decision step.
blocked.no_dispute: Available once PayPal has opened the dispute.
blocked.not_owned: This dispute doesn't belong to your workspace.
blocked.already_requested: Decision requested. The outcome shows here once PayPal reports it.

scenario.decisionError: PayPal didn't take the decision ({code}). Try again once PayPal offers the step.
scenario.offered: PayPal now offers the decision step (adjudicate). Use the sandbox control to stand in for PayPal's review.
scenario.ctaHint: A card payment, a chargeback and PayPal's real states: about 25 minutes.
scenario.stillWaiting: Still waiting. PayPal or our server may be slow.
